name: jetc-profile
description: Tools/perf/jetc-profile/profile.mjs and its Jet twin jetc-profile/profile/run.jet, the Jet-named reports from the perf script output of a jetc process. The fixtures hold a perf script of seven samples and a source map over a stand-in checkout: Rust hash suffixes and +0x offsets (only lowercase ones go), each jetc_<crate> as its Jet module, `__jet_` names decoded (byte escapes, a UTF-8 é, $ and [generated] names) or kept flat when a source file declares them, bare names placed by the one file that declares them or by their prefix, declaration locations with `(current source)` for a file changed since the map, recursion counted once per sample, `(inlined)` in any case, a `;` in a frame, CRLF lines, a header with no blank line before it, and [unknown] and bare-address roots. The cases cover analyze (all five reports), analyze without the map, with an older map schema and with no samples; needs-dwarf for a summary that needs DWARF, one that does not, one without the field and a missing file; render of folded stacks (XML escapes, unreadable lines and zero counts skipped, a label cut inside a surrogate pair) and of none; and the usage refusals.
